# Review: C-401 Debutanizer, Section 5.1 Column Control

**Verdict: do not issue for configuration.** Two findings (R-01, R-02) would produce wrong or conflicting configuration. The rest are missing content that FAT cannot test.

## Findings

| ID | Location | Issue | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| R-01 | TIC-405 description | **Action contradicts itself.** "Reverse acting" means the output rises when PV falls. The text says the output increases steam flow when temperature rises, which is direct action. It is also the wrong process response, because a hot tray should get less steam. | Rewrite: "When TT-405 rises, TIC-405 decreases the FIC-420 setpoint." Process engineering must confirm the action before the text is reissued. |
| R-02 | TIC-405 tuning vs. tuning sheet | **Two sets of values.** The narrative lists Kc = 0.8, Ti = 12 min. Last month's tuning sheet lists Kc = 1.2, Ti = 8 min. The narrative does not say which is current. | Do not choose one here. Ask the controls lead which is authoritative. Then see R-03. |
| R-03 | TIC-405 tuning line | **Numbers in prose.** Tuning does not belong in a narrative, so this violates the single-source-of-truth rule. It is also the cause of R-02. | Delete the line. Add: "Tuning values are in the tuning sheet, rev. [x]." |
| R-04 | FIC-420 manual statement | **Cascade behavior undefined.** The text does not say what TIC-405 does when FIC-420 is in manual (track, hold, or wind up). It does not say how the loop returns to cascade without a bump, or who may do it. | Add FR items for TIC-405 initialization and tracking, bumpless return to cascade, and the operator prompt. |
| R-05 | TT-405 failure statement | **Untestable.** "Should hold approximately its last output" has no pass/fail criterion. It also does not define bad-PV detection, the TIC-405 mode after failure, the alarm, or the FIC-420 behavior. It never says who recovers the loop or how. | Write: "On bad quality of TT-405, TIC-405 goes to manual and holds its last output. The system annunciates [alarm ref]. The operator must select a mode to recover." Define the detection method in the bad-PV list. |
| R-06 | LIC-411 → FIC-410, FIC-412 | **Action and mode missing.** There is no direction for the level loop (level up → reflux up?). No cascade initialization, limits, or mode behavior is given. "Fixed operator setpoint" for FIC-412 is vague. With distillate fixed, level alone sets reflux, so this scheme interacts with TIC-405. | Add the action, limits (by setpoint-list reference), and mode behavior. Ask process to confirm the scheme is intended. Replace "fixed" with "operator-set, range per the setpoint list." |
| R-07 | LIC-402, PIC-430 | **Action and behavior missing.** There is no direction for either loop, and no valve action for PV-430 (open raises or lowers pressure?). There are no limits, overrides, or mode behavior. | Add PV, output, action, and mode behavior for each loop. |
| R-08 | Whole section | **Abnormal handling missing.** Only TT-405 is covered. Bad PV for the other loops, comms loss, power loss and restart, and fail positions for FV-402, PV-430, and the FIC-410, FIC-412, and FIC-420 valves are all undefined. | Add section 8 content, with fail positions in a table that references the instrument index. |
| R-09 | Whole section | **No requirement IDs or test methods.** | Assign FR-C401-NNN to each requirement, with a FAT test method. |
| R-10 | Whole section | **No state or sequence context.** No states, transitions, or permissives are defined (startup, shutdown, hold), so loop behavior in each state is unspecified. | Add the ISA-106 state table. Define loop modes per state. |
| R-11 | Whole section | **No references.** The text does not point to the instrument index, cause-and-effect chart, alarm database, or SIS SRS. Column high-pressure and high-level protection must reference the SRS, not appear here. | Add references. Keep logic and trip values out of prose. |
| R-12 | Wording | **STE issues.** "Should hold" is not a requirement. "Controls", "sets", "manipulates", and "runs" are used loosely for the same relationships. | Use a consistent verb per relationship. State requirements as "The system shall …" or in imperative form. Remove "approximately". |
| R-13 | Open items | **None listed.** | See below. |

## Suggested open items

| # | Item | Owner | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Confirm TIC-405 action and the current tuning set (R-01, R-02) | Process / controls lead | *to be assigned* |
| 2 | Confirm the reflux and distillate scheme (R-06) | Process | *to be assigned* |
| 3 | Define fail positions and bad-PV handling for all loops (R-05, R-08) | Controls | *to be assigned* |
| 4 | Operations sign-off on modes and prompts | Operations | *to be assigned* |

I did not assign owners or dates because the excerpt does not give them.

## Checklist status

- **Fail:** SSoT, requirement IDs and test methods, state entry permissives and exits, abnormal handling, references, SIS referencing, open items.
- **Not applicable yet:** sequence step tables (none in the excerpt).
- **Pass:** sentence length is within the STE limit. Wording needs the edits in R-12.

Once R-01 and R-02 are resolved, I can draft a corrected section 5.1 with IDs and the regulatory-control table.
